facts.claim: Santo Wines (winery of the Union of Santorini Cooperatives) is in Pyrgos, Santorini; its Wine Tourism Center is 'located in Pyrgos village next to Santo Wines winery with breathtaking volcano view' and is open all year round. Venue type: winery.

Santo Wines has a Weddings page: 'Imagine saying "I do" with the Caldera as your witness, surrounded by loved ones against the backdrop of the setting sun.' Its homepage says 'From the terraces of our winery, with a stunning view over the caldera'.

Santo Wines weddings are arranged through its Event Manager (request form on the Weddings page). Ceremony options, capacity, rooms and exclusive-use terms are not published. Standout: a winery with a restaurant and wine tasting at its Wine Tourism Center.
Venetsanos Winery's Wedding & Events page: the winery 'has also been transformed in order to host the most exclusive events and weddings on the island of Santorini'; it is built on 4 levels.

Venetsanos Winery: 'At the second level is located the Upper Terrace a magnificent terrace area of 250m2 that overlooks the caldera.' This open-air area 'can host your ceremony, reception, private dinner, gala & other events.'

Venetsanos Winery Upper Terrace maximum capacity: approximately 100 seated at round tables, 160 standing reception, or 100 theatre style (chairs only). Rooms and exclusive use not published; costs and availability on request.

Aroma Suites (Fira, Santorini) has a Weddings page: 'We host small ceremonies on our rooftop terrace above the caldera in Fira: elopements for two, vow renewals, and celebrations of up to 15-20 guests. The rooftop faces the volcano and the open sea.'

Aroma Suites ceremony options as stated: Caldera Ceremonies on the rooftop terrace ('with the volcano and the Aegean in front of you', 'on the cliff, away from Fira's main walkway', up to 15-20 guests); Elopements for Two; Vow Renewals; ceremonies 'at sunset, in the morning, or after dark'.

Aroma Suites lists three ways to marry: rent the rooftop terrace; 'Buy out the whole hotel' (additional rooms at a nearby property for larger groups, reception on the terrace at extra cost); or have the hotel arrange details at extra cost. Pricing on request (a fee applies). Standout: the couple can stay in the Honeymoon Suite 'with the caldera right outside your window'. Total room count not published on the Weddings page.

Katikies Hotels' Events page lists Katikies Garden (Fira) spaces 'ideal for wedding ceremonies': Selene Restaurant (seated outside/inside/lunch 55/20/30, standing 150), St. Joseph Wine Cave (seated 36, standing 50) and Garden Pool Bar (seated 36, standing 100). Not qualified for the caldera list: neither this page nor the Katikies Garden home page states a caldera view for the property or these spaces.

Katikies Garden home page: a 5-star converted monastery in Fira with 40 suites; 'Fira is situated on the island's famed Caldera' (the town, not the property); FAQ says some suites offer sea views and '180° views are offered from the infinity pool'. The entrance is on the path and accessible only by foot.

Pyrgos Restaurant (Pyrgos) has a Weddings & Events page listing five halls (Central, Panorama, Saint Fotini, Small Private Hall, The Garden) plus a Bridal Room. Panorama Hall: upper level, 35-60 guests, 85 m2, for 'wedding ceremonies, and receptions', private terrace 'with stunning views of the island'. Not qualified: no caldera-view wording on the pages read.

insider_details.detail: Santo Wines and Venetsanos Winery are both wineries with caldera-facing terraces, so a sunset ceremony and a wine-led reception can sit in one place; Venetsanos publishes terrace capacity (about 100 seated), Santo Wines does not, so ask its Event Manager early.
Aroma Suites suits elopements and micro weddings only: its rooftop ceremony space takes up to 15-20 guests, and a larger group means a hotel buyout plus rooms at a nearby property.
Katikies Garden's entrance is reachable only on foot, so plan luggage and guest access in Fira if it is used as a guest base.
